title: Same style on every owner page
steps: Open all 19 owner pages at 1366 px and compare font, colors, menu, header, icons and buttons.
expected: Every page opens and these style properties are the same on all pages.
actual: All 19 pages opened (HTTP 200) with one font (-apple-system), 16px text, one background, the same side menu (19 links) and header, one icon set (Bootstrap Icons) and one primary button color.

title: Phone layout
steps: Open all 19 pages at 390 px phone size and use the Menu button.
expected: Same font, no sideways page scrolling, and the menu opens.
actual: All 19 pages fit 390 px without sideways page scrolling, with the same font; the Menu button opened the menu.

title: Manage Farm Branches
steps: Add a sample branch.
expected: The branch is saved and can be selected elsewhere.
actual: Branch saved; message: Branch added successfully! Your farm branch list has been updated. OK

title: Manage Flocks: create
steps: Add a 50-bird layer flock to the new branch.
expected: Saved; first Flock ID in the branch is 01.
actual: Saved as Flock ID 01; message: Successfully Added! Your operation was completed successfully. OK

title: Manage Production Records
steps: Record 12 medium eggs today.
expected: Saved and listed.
actual: Message: Successfully Added! Production record added. OK

title: Manage Mortality Records
steps: Record 2 deaths in the 50-bird flock.
expected: Saved; the live count becomes 48.
actual: Live count 50 to 48; message: Successfully Added! Mortality record added. Flock 01 (Alpha Test 11250101) was updated. OK

title: Manage Health Records
steps: Add a vaccination record.
expected: Saved and listed.
actual: Listed; message: Successfully Added! Health record added. OK

title: Manage Feed and Inventory
steps: Add 10 kg of feed at 20.00.
expected: Saved and listed.
actual: 10 kg listed; message: Successfully Added! Your operation was completed successfully. OK

title: Manage Revenue
steps: Sell 10 eggs at 8.00 and open the receipt.
expected: Sale saved; receipt shows the buyer and 80.00.
actual: Sale saved (Successfully Added! Your operation was completed successfully. OK); receipt shows the buyer and 80.00.

title: Manage Expenses
steps: Add a 30.00 feed expense.
expected: Saved and listed.
actual: Listed; message: Successfully Added! Your operation was completed successfully. OK

title: 2.2 Automated profit and loss
steps: Open the Dashboard for the sample branch after AT-09 and AT-10.
expected: Revenue 80.00, expenses 30.00, net profit 50.00.
actual: Revenue 80.00, expenses 30.00, net profit 50.00.

title: Cancel a deletion
steps: Click Delete on an expense, then Cancel.
expected: A confirmation prompt appears and Cancel keeps the record.
actual: Prompt: "? Confirm Action  Are you sure you want to delete this record? Alpha expense A  Cancel Confirm". After Cancel the record remained.

title: Confirm a deletion
steps: Add a second expense, delete it and confirm.
expected: It is removed and the totals are correct.
actual: Message: Successfully Deleted! Your operation was completed successfully. OK. Record removed and totals returned to 80/30/50.

title: Leave a form with unsaved changes
steps: Type in Add Expense, click close, then choose Cancel.
expected: A prompt warns about unsaved changes and Cancel keeps them.
actual: "? Confirm Action  Discard unsaved changes?  Cancel Confirm" Choosing Cancel kept the typed text.

title: Correct a saved record
steps: Edit the 30.00 expense to 35.00 with a reason.
expected: Saved; Dashboard shows expenses 35.00 and net profit 45.00.
actual: Message: Successfully Updated! Your operation was completed successfully. OK. Expenses 35.00, net profit 45.00.

title: Audit Logging
steps: Open Change History after AT-15.
expected: Shows the user, reason, and before and after values.
actual: Entry shows user, reason, amount 30.00 before and 35.00 after.

title: Shared components
steps: Inspect the buttons, tables, dialogs, inputs and selects on 7 record modules and 3 record forms.
expected: The same familiar components are used throughout.
actual: All 7 record modules use the same Add button, table and dialog components; the 3 record forms use the same field and button components.

title: Labelled buttons and uncrowded width
steps: On every page look for unlabelled buttons and sideways scrolling.
expected: None found.
actual: On all 19 pages every visible button has text or an accessible label and no page scrolls sideways.

title: Text contrast
steps: Measure text contrast on every page at 1366 px.
expected: Text meets the WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratio (4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text).
actual: First run (Fail): 19 style combinations were below WCAG AA, the lowest 1.96:1. After the fix (599c071): none below on 3 signed-out pages and 20 owner pages at 1366 px and 19 pages at 390 px; smallest text 11.2 px.
review: Text on gradients or transparent backgrounds and text inside charts was not measured. The manuscript sets no contrast value; WCAG AA was used as the reference. Retested in a second test account (userx).

title: Login messages
steps: Submit an unknown account, then an invalid email with no password.
expected: Clear messages that do not reveal whether the account exists.
actual: "Incorrect email or password. Please try again."; "Enter a valid email address."; "Password is required."

title: Invalid input messages
steps: Enter production -5, mortality 999, a flock of 0, an expense of -5, and a future health date.
expected: Each is refused with a short message naming the problem; nothing is saved.

actual.production -5: Production quantity must be greater than zero.
actual.mortality 999: Mortality quantity cannot exceed the selected flock quantity (48).
actual.flock 0: Enter at least 1 chicken for a new flock.
actual.future health date: The health record date cannot be in the future.

title: Script text in a field
steps: Save an expense description containing HTML script text, then open 5 pages.
expected: It is shown as text and does not run.
actual: Shown as plain text on 5 pages; no script ran. The record was deleted.

title: Other accounts' records
steps: Request 24 flock, production, sale and expense records not in this account.
expected: None can be opened (HTTP 404).
actual: All 24 requests for records not in this account returned HTTP 404.

title: Signed-out access
steps: Open every page and the API while signed out; open the site over http.
expected: Login is required and http redirects to https.
actual: All 19 pages redirected to Login; API HTTP 403; http redirected to https (HTTP 301).

title: Scenario Analysis
steps: With egg and meat sales, apply a 10% egg price increase.
expected: Only the egg part of revenue rises by 10%.
actual: Total 380.00 with 80.00 from eggs became 388.00.

title: 2.3 Machine learning forecasting
steps: Open Forecasting for a new branch; add six months of sample records through the API; open it again.
expected: First shows insufficient history; then shows forecasts equal to a separate run of the model on the same data.
actual: New branch first showed "Insufficient history". After six months of sample records: revenue 7,959.60, expected profit 2,361.48, eggs 1,105.50; equal to a separate run of the same model code. Accuracy on real farm data was not tested.
review: The first run stopped as Fail because the test script looked for "Revenue Forecast" in mixed case and the page displays it in capitals. The page was rechecked and the values compared.

title: 2.4 Report generation
steps: Generate and download the monthly report; compare with saved records.
expected: Excel file downloads and its totals equal the records.
actual: Downloaded monthly_report_2026-11-01_to_2026-11-25.xlsx; Summary contains revenue 380.00 and expenses 235.00, equal to the saved records.

title: 2.1 Financial data recording
steps: Review AT-09, AT-10 and AT-15.
expected: Income and expenses are saved and can be corrected.
actual: AT-09, AT-10 and AT-15 passed.

title: 2.5 Rooster age estimation
steps: Upload a clear rooster spur photo and run Quick Age Estimate.
expected: An estimate in months is shown and labelled experimental.
actual: "Estimated age: Experimental estimate: 13.0 months" in 58 s.

title: Rooster estimator refuses a non-rooster image
steps: Upload the SmartPoultry logo image.
expected: No age is given; the system asks for a clear chicken or spur photo.
actual: "No age estimate was generated." in 47 s.

title: Notification Management
steps: Open Notifications after the tests above.
expected: New activity is listed.
actual: 42 notifications listed, including "Successfully added a new flock of layers ... flock 03 (Alpha Test ...)"; the bell showed 42.
review: The first run recorded an incorrect bell value, so the page was rechecked.

title: Feedback Management (owner side)
steps: Submit a sample feedback message.
expected: It is saved and listed under My Feedback.
actual: Listed under My Feedback; message: Changes Saved Successfully! Thank you. Your feedback was submitted. OK

title: Analytics & Predictions page
steps: Open ML Predictions.
expected: Six-month projection using the recent-trend method described in manuscript v28, Screen 22.
actual: First run (Fail): the method matched Screen 22, but the unfinished current month was counted, so revenue was projected to fall to 0 by April 2027; the page also named the method "SQLite". After the fix (599c071): projection 8,256.00 rising to 10,056.00, equal to a separate calculation from the saved records, with a correct method name.
review: An earlier version of this record said the page contradicted the manuscript by not using Random Forest. That was wrong: Screen 22 states that this page uses a recent-trend projection and that Random Forest is on the Forecasting page. Retested in a second test account (userx) that has completed months.

title: Manage Flocks: archive
steps: Mark a sample flock as sold, then open Flock History.
expected: It moves to Flock History.
actual: Flock marked sold appears in Flock History.

title: Page loading time
steps: Load every page three times in the browser.
expected: Dashboard loads within 3 seconds (manuscript requirement).
actual: Dashboard median 0.34 s; slowest page dashboard 0.34 s (3 loads each, site already awake, this computer's connection).
review: Measured on one computer with the site awake. The first visit after the site sleeps was not measured.

title: Report and forecast time
steps: Time the AT-27 download and the AT-26 forecast page.
expected: Report within 10 s; forecast within 10 s (manuscript requirement).
actual: Report download 2.51 s; forecast page 2.71 s.

title: Transaction time
steps: Save five sample expenses through the API and time each.
expected: Each save completes within 3 seconds.
actual: Five saves took 0.09 to 0.14 s; the five records were deleted.

title: Owner controls own settings
steps: Change one notification setting, reload, and restore it.
expected: The change is kept and can be reversed.
actual: Email alerts setting changed, stayed changed after reload, and was restored to its original value.

title: Owner can see own profile
steps: Open Manage Profile without changing it.
expected: All five personal fields are shown and editable.
actual: Name, username, email and phone are shown in editable fields. Values were not changed.

title: Existing records untouched
steps: Compare the account's earlier records before and after all tests.
expected: None changed or lost.
actual: All 4 records that were in the account before testing are unchanged.

title: Messages shown during testing
steps: Collect every success message shown in AT-03 to AT-38.
expected: Messages are short and polite, with no error codes or technical text.

messages: Branch added successfully! Your farm branch list has been updated. OK
Changes Saved Successfully! Processed 1 image(s). 1 age estimate(s) generated. OK
Changes Saved Successfully! Thank you. Your feedback was submitted. OK
Successfully Added! Health record added. OK
Successfully Added! Mortality record added. Flock 01 (Alpha Test 11250101) was updated. OK
Successfully Added! Production record added. OK
Successfully Added! Your operation was completed successfully. OK
Successfully Deleted! Your operation was completed successfully. OK
Successfully Updated! Notification settings updated. OK
Successfully Updated! Your operation was completed successfully. OK

review: Checks wording only. Whether the messages feel helpful and polite is for the researchers to rate.

title: Rooster estimate time
steps: Time AT-29 and AT-30 (Quick Age Estimate).
expected: Machine learning predictions within 10 seconds (manuscript).
actual: A spur photo took 58 s and a non-rooster image 47 s.
review: Added after the run using its measured times. If the 10-second requirement is meant only for financial forecasts (2.71 s), the manuscript should say so.

title: Sign out
steps: Sign out, then open the Dashboard address.
expected: Login is required again.
actual: Redirected to the login page.

title: Administrator Dashboard totals
steps: Open the Admin Dashboard and compare the user cards with the user list.
expected: Cards equal the listed users.
actual: Total, active and inactive cards (13, 13, 0) equal the number of listed users.

title: User search and status filter
steps: Search for Account B and for an unknown name; filter by status.
expected: Only matching users are listed.
actual: Account B was the only match for its username; an unknown name matched none; active 13 + inactive 0 = 13.

title: Owner cannot open admin pages
steps: Sign in as a farm owner (Account B) and open four admin pages.
expected: None is shown (refused or redirected).
actual: HTTP [403, 403, 302, 302]: two refused and two redirected away; no admin page was shown.
review: A first run counted a redirect to the owner's own dashboard as a page that opened; the check was corrected.

title: Signed-out access to admin pages
steps: Open three admin pages while signed out.
expected: Login is required.
actual: All redirected to Login.

title: Disable and enable a user
steps: Disable Account B, try its open session and sign-in, then enable it.
expected: Disabled user cannot use the system; enabled user can; owners cannot use the control.
actual: An owner could not use the control (HTTP 403). Disabled: shown Inactive, the open session ended and sign-in was refused. Re-enabled: shown Active and sign-in worked.
review: The owner refusal was rechecked with a valid security token: "You do not have permission to access this page."

title: Feedback review and response
steps: Owner submits feedback; admin filters, reads and answers it; owner checks it.
expected: Admin can read and answer; the owner sees the response.
actual: The message appeared under New, opened in full, and was answered and marked Resolved; the owner saw the response and status.
review: The screenshot shows only the test message; other messages were removed before capture.

title: Delete feedback with confirmation
steps: Delete the test message: Cancel first, then Confirm.
expected: Cancel keeps it; Confirm removes only it.
actual: A prompt appeared; Cancel kept the message; Confirm removed only that message.

title: Delete-user confirmation
steps: Click Delete for Account B, then Cancel.
expected: A confirmation prompt appears and Cancel keeps the account.
actual: "? Confirm Action  Delete alphab11241506? This cannot be undone.  Cancel Confirm" Cancel kept the account. No user was deleted.

title: Admin cannot disable or delete own account
steps: Look at the signed-in administrator's own row.
expected: Its Disable and Delete buttons are turned off.
actual: Exactly one row, the signed-in administrator, has Disable and Delete turned off.

title: Password reset requests page
steps: Open the page without changing anything.
expected: Pending and resolved requests are shown.
actual: Page opened with pending and resolved sections. Viewed only; no request was changed.

title: Password reset needs the user's answers
steps: Open the reset page for Account B without submitting.
expected: The user's recovery answers are required.
actual: The form asks for the account's recovery answers as well as a new password. Nothing was submitted.

title: Export users button
steps: Follow the Export button on the Admin Dashboard.
expected: A file of users is downloaded.
actual: Export opens /admin/accounts/userprofile/: HTTP 403, text/html; no file is produced.
review: Fixed in 6d96a51: Export downloads a CSV of the listed users. Passes local tests; live, signed-out visitors go to Login and an owner gets HTTP 403. It stays Fail until an administrator retests the live button.

title: Administrator levels
steps: On a local copy, sign in as staff (not superuser) and try to deactivate a superuser and to deactivate and delete another staff administrator.
expected: A staff administrator cannot disable or delete administrators.
actual: Staff could deactivate a superuser, and deactivate and delete another staff administrator. Deleting a superuser was refused. After the fix (6d96a51), the same local test refuses every one of these actions; a superuser can still do them.
review: First result Fail. Found by reading the code and tested on a local copy only, never on the live site. The expected result is the reviewer's; the manuscript requires role-based access but does not describe administrator levels. Disabling the only superuser would lock the team out of functions only a superuser has.

title: User list page buttons
steps: Look at the page buttons under the user list.
expected: Page buttons move between pages.
actual: Buttons 1, 2 and 3 are always shown, even for one result, and have no action; all users are already on one page. Fixed in 6d96a51: the buttons were removed.
review: Confirmed in the page code. The fix is deployed and passes a local test; it stays Fail until an administrator retests the live page.
